extracted.extracted_text: SBI Alert: Dear customer, your SBI YONO account KYC has expired today. Your account will be blocked within 24 hours. Update KYC immediately by clicking bit.ly/sbi-kyc-2026 and enter the OTP to verify. -SBI
extracted.claim: KYC has expired; account will be blocked within 24 hours
extracted.requested_action: Click the link and enter OTP

signals.title: Link does not match SBI
signals.explanation: The message claims to be from State Bank of India, but the link goes to bit.ly, which is not an SBI domain.

signals.title: Asks for OTP
signals.explanation: Banks never ask customers to enter an OTP on a link sent by SMS; an OTP is what a fraudster needs to complete a transaction.

signals.title: Bank impersonation
signals.explanation: The message uses SBI branding and a high-risk request through a channel that cannot be verified.
signals.uncertainty: The sender ID is not visible in pasted text, so the true sender cannot be confirmed.

signals.title: KYC expiry threat
signals.explanation: KYC-expiry messages with a link are a common scam pattern; real KYC updates happen in the bank app or branch.

signals.title: Account block threat
signals.explanation: Threatening to block the account creates fear so the reader acts without checking.
signals.evidence: Your account will be blocked within 24 hours

signals.title: Urgency
signals.explanation: A 24-hour deadline and 'immediately' pressure the reader to act now.

signals.title: Shortened link
signals.explanation: A shortener hides the real destination of the link.
signals.uncertainty: The final destination of the short link was not opened or checked.

recommendation: Do not click the link or share any OTP. Open the official SBI app or call the number on the back of your card to check your KYC status.
what_to_verify: Check your KYC status inside the official SBI YONO app, not through the link
Confirm the sender ID with the bank's published SMS headers
Call the number printed on the back of your card if in doubt
inconsistencies: A bank KYC update is requested through a public URL shortener instead of an official bank domain
notes: message_content deductions were capped at 45 points
caveats: Sender identity cannot be verified from text alone
disclaimer: Trust Score is a risk indicator, not proof of authenticity or fraud.
